title: Frontend implementation for nested folder management and navigation

requirements.summary: Implement folder navigation state management tracking current folderId in frontend
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a folder updates the current folderId state
File display area shows only files belonging to the current folderId
Folder list shows only direct children of current folderId
Navigation state persists during component lifecycle

file_operations.description: Add currentFolderId state tracking using useState. Update handleFolderClick to set currentFolderId when a folder is clicked. Pass currentFolderId to useListFilesByFolder and useListFolders queries to filter displayed items. Initialize with null for root level.

Add useListFoldersByParent query hook that accepts parentFolderId parameter and calls backend listFolders, then filters results client-side by parentFolderId. Include proper query key with parentFolderId to enable caching per folder level.
Modify useListFilesByFolder to accept optional folderId parameter and pass it to backend.listFilesByFolder(folderId). Update query key to include folderId for proper cache segmentation.

requirements.summary: Add breadcrumb navigation component showing full folder path with clickable links
acceptanceCriteria: Breadcrumbs display complete folder hierarchy from root to current folder
Each breadcrumb segment is clickable and navigates to that folder level
Breadcrumb separator visually indicates hierarchy (e.g., '/' or '>')
Current folder is highlighted or styled differently from ancestors

file_operations.description: Enhance component to accept currentFolderId prop and onNavigate callback. Build folder path by traversing parentFolderId chain using folder metadata from cache. Render clickable breadcrumb segments with ChevronRight separator. Style current folder differently (e.g., font-semibold). Add 'Home' or 'Root' as first breadcrumb that navigates to null folderId.

Wire FolderBreadcrumb component into the page layout above the folder grid. Pass currentFolderId and setCurrentFolderId as onNavigate callback. Position breadcrumb in the toolbar area or directly above content.

Add useGetFolderPath query hook that accepts folderId and returns array of folder objects from root to target. Implement by recursively fetching parent folders using getFolderMetadata until reaching root (null parentFolderId). Cache with queryKey including folderId.

requirements.summary: Add back button that navigates to the parent folder
acceptanceCriteria: Back button is visible when user is not at root level
Clicking back button navigates to parent folder
Back button is disabled or hidden when at root level
Back button includes appropriate icon (e.g., arrow left)

file_operations.description: Add back button to toolbar using ArrowLeft icon from lucide-react. Show button only when currentFolderId is not null. On click, fetch current folder metadata to get parentFolderId, then setCurrentFolderId to parent. Position button at the start of the toolbar.

requirements.summary: Ensure file upload functionality works within any folder by passing current folderId
acceptanceCriteria: File upload component accepts current folderId as parameter
Uploaded files are associated with the current folderId in metadata
Files uploaded in a folder only appear when viewing that specific folder
Upload progress and success messages indicate the target folder

file_operations.description: Add folderId prop (string | null) to component. Pass folderId to useUploadFile mutation when uploading. Update success toast message to include folder name if folderId is provided (e.g., 'File uploaded to [Folder Name]').
Pass currentFolderId to FileUpload component. Ensure FileUpload is rendered in the folders view and receives the active folderId state.

Modify useUploadFile mutation to accept folderId parameter in the upload function. Pass folderId to backend.uploadFileChunk. Invalidate both 'files' and folder-specific query keys after successful upload.

requirements.summary: Ensure files are isolated to their specific folder location
acceptanceCriteria: File queries filter by current folderId to show only files in that folder
Files uploaded to folder A do not appear when viewing folder B
Root-level files (no folderId) only appear at root level
Moving a file updates its folderId to the new location

file_operations.description: Ensure FileList component receives currentFolderId and only displays files matching that folderId. Use useListFilesByFolder(currentFolderId) instead of useListFiles() to fetch folder-specific files.
Add folderId prop (string | null). Replace useListFiles with useListFilesByFolder(folderId) when folderId prop is provided. Ensure filtering logic respects folder isolation.
Ensure useListFilesByFolder properly passes folderId to backend.listFilesByFolder. Update cache invalidation in file mutations to invalidate both global 'files' key and folder-specific keys.

requirements.summary: Fix folder creation to properly display newly created folders immediately
acceptanceCriteria: Creating a new folder triggers immediate cache invalidation and refetch of folder list
Newly created folder appears in the folder list without requiring page refresh
Folder creation mutation returns the created folder object for optimistic updates
Error states are handled and displayed if folder creation fails

file_operations.description: Modify useCreateFolder mutation to invalidate query keys ['folders'] and parent-specific folder query keys after successful creation. Add onSuccess callback that triggers queryClient.invalidateQueries. Add error handling with toast notifications for failure cases.

Ensure folder list refetches automatically after folder creation by relying on React Query cache invalidation. Add loading state handling during folder creation. Display success toast with created folder name.

requirements.summary: Maintain separate independent storage areas for My Files and My Folder sections
acceptanceCriteria: My Files section displays only files with null or empty folderId
My Folder section displays folder hierarchy and files within folders
Files uploaded in My Files remain separate from My Folder contents
Navigation between sections is clear and maintains separate state

file_operations.description: Ensure 'files' view uses FileList without folderId (showing only root files with null folderId). Keep FileUpload in Dashboard for uploading root-level files (pass folderId=null). Add clear visual distinction that this section is for loose files only.

Ensure this page manages folder hierarchy independently from Dashboard. Display folder tree and folder-specific files only. Keep state isolated using currentFolderId. Add page title 'My Folders' to distinguish from 'My Files'.

Ensure 'My Files' navigation item routes to /files (Dashboard) and 'My Folders' or folder tree items route to /folders (FoldersPage). Keep navigation items visually distinct to clarify the separation.
Add useListRootFiles query hook that calls backend.listFilesByFolder(null) to fetch only root-level files. Use separate query key ['root-files'] to isolate cache from folder-specific queries.

Add mode prop ('root' | 'folder') to determine data source. When mode='root', use useListRootFiles. When mode='folder', use useListFilesByFolder(folderId). Display appropriate empty state messages for each mode.
